title: Slides
lead: Maintain published collections for banners, carousels, products and testimonials while templates own the visual structure.

sections.title: Build a collection
steps: Open Slides → New collection. Enter a name and choose the content type, for example a banner collection.
Add items with image, alternative text, title, text, link and the other fields offered for that content type. Choose public files from Images; upload new files in Images first.
Arrange item order and enable only finished items. Save the collection, then use Edit from Overview for subsequent changes.

sections.title: Assign and insert
steps: Choose Template key to select a compatible position declared in mustacheSlots of the currently active template. The template name is read from its manifest.
Choose Mustache key for direct references without page, marker or location fields. Save and reopen to confirm the selected channel.
Saving an explicit mode makes the channels exclusive. Preserved assignments are inactive in Mustache mode; they can be reused after returning to Template key.

sections.title: Motion and recovery
steps: Autoplay starts disabled. When enabled, use a suitable interval and template controls that support pause, keyboard navigation and reduced motion.
History and Trash preserve recovery. Missing template locations produce administrative warnings without deleting assignments.

sections.title: Raw slide collections
steps: slides:data(key: active-template location key) returns name, contentType, type, autoplay, interval and items: id, title, text, image, alt, href, label, attribution, price. Only live published collections and enabled matching items are returned. Template/filter rules still apply. slides:location remains compatible with existing card partials.

Bind slides:data as promotion. Example: {{#promotion.items}}{{/promotion.items}}. The plugin supplies data; the template supplies accessible carousel controls, CSS and JavaScript. No script may be authored inside the HTML editor.

sections.title: Direct plugin data and template positions
body: Create a set with a stable slug-shaped ID, add and enable items, choose its content type, maximum displayed slides, interval, transition effect/duration/orientation and publish. The reference returns items and transition settings; the receiving layout supplies the carousel markup, styles and behavior.
steps: Use the stable identifier or slug without dots. Explicit id.<value> and slug.<value> selectors disambiguate reserved names.
Place named query parameters before field paths; use sections (#) and inverted sections (^) for finite iteration and empty states.
Keep presentation in the receiving layout. Template positions require manifest declarations and source-plugin assignments.

sections.title: Search, sort and paginate the overview
body: The overview uses shared CMS table controls. Search and status/type filters are at the top; Clear resets filters. Click a column heading to select ascending or descending order; the active arrow identifies the current ordering.
steps: Use the icon controls and their translated tooltips. Search, clear and ordering restart at page one; page navigation preserves the selected filters and order.

All result rows and the seven-position pager scroll together with the page. The pager follows the complete table or grid without covering any result; only wide tables scroll horizontally. Ellipsis buttons open upward menus containing earlier or later pages outside the three displayed numbers. Use the keyboard or a page button to navigate.
Read the total results, displayed range/count and page totals below the pager. Unavailable directions and empty catalogs retain disabled controls.

sections.title: Exclusive delivery channels
steps: Template key exposes this record only through its assigned template positions. Direct slides.<id-or-slug> references are unavailable.
Mustache key exposes typed data through slides.<id-or-slug>.<field>; render items with standard sections in the receiving layout. Template assignments are preserved but inactive.

Legacy records retain previous access until saved with an explicit mode. Review existing publications before saving the selected channel. Missing simple references appear as literal text; missing collections do not iterate.
body: Delivery mode is stored on the record and checked by all read channels.
